intro: The Crate of Lightforge Ingots contains rare consecrated metal recovered to forge an instrument capable of defeating the necromancer Morbent Fel. Packed securely for transport, it is destined for the anvils of the Dwarven District in Stormwind.

p: Lightforge iron is an exceptionally rare material, inherently suited to channel holy power against dark entities. Packed away securely in this crate, the ingots represent the hope of Duskwood in its bitter struggle against the necromancer Morbent Fel, whose shadowy protections shrug off ordinary steel. Ordinary smiths cannot simply work with this metal; it takes an artisan who understands its temper and respects its sacred nature.
